messages.text: The eligible refund is **BRL 150.00**. Please confirm the exact proposal using the button on its card; a message in chat won’t confirm it. The refund can only go to the original payment, not a new card. If the old card was cancelled, its issuer handles any credit, and the shop can’t promise where or when it appears (refund-policy/v2/payment).
The customer confirmed request prop-be63a4e79e9b4aa8 and a staff member approved it, so it is ready to be paid.

The refund of **BRL 150.00** has been recorded in the shop’s test ledger. Receipt: **R-00000001**. It is not a bank transfer, and the shop doesn’t provide a date for when money may appear on a card (refund-policy/v2/payout).
You’re welcome! The refund has already been recorded under receipt **R-00000001**.
